title: Agent Firewall
summary: Let an AI agent spend from a vault only through one allowed program and under a per-call limit, with the owner able to tighten the rules at any time.
what: Agent Firewall is an Anchor 0.32.1 policy vault. The agent can only move lamports via execute_hook, which enforces the agent key, an allowed target program and a spend limit before CPI-ing into that program.
app_note: The page at /dapps/agent-firewall/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/agent_firewall. The lab only changed declare_id to unique lab programs.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/agent-firewall/, switch to Devnet, connect a wallet and call initialize with your own agent key and allowed_target HNJzGkkbyneDBD6xD8XjLsdhoDmKnjkdBvfHUW6MWtHP.
try_steps.see: Your policy vault PDA ["vault", your wallet].
try_steps.ran: initialize, deposit, execute_hook with CPI, update_policy (see steps).

diagram: owner --initialize/deposit--> vault PDA(policy); agent --execute_hook--> checks(agent,target,limit) -> recipient +SOL -> CPI target; owner --update_policy--> new limit
innovation: The agent never signs arbitrary transactions with the funds: every spend is routed through a program that checks who, where and how much first.
exercises: Why reject the vault as recipient?
How would you add a daily cap and an owner withdraw?
